'''Grund'messel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] merchant who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He owned a stand in the [[Old Galactic Market]]'s [[Concourse Bazaar]], from which he sold heavy armor.

==Behind the scenes==
Grund'messel appears in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a heavy armor vendor on Coruscant.
